note: mono-measure-mintpairs-1115-mm: copy of mono-measure-mintpairs-1115.json, repinned to master-mono-1115 (0.36.264-mono1). RUN FIRST (prepared 2026-11-15, lane mono-measure, NOT RUN). D6 = docs/139 rank 3 (superinstructions for hot pairs) needs the pairs from play first, not from the monohost phases (docs/139 §3). Build ts3native.asi.mono-measure-1115 (feature/mono-measure-1115, 0.36.264-mono1) = master aae8e1d6 + [MonoFast] PairCount (mintpairs.cpp, TEST-RUN TOOL, default 0): the mint dispatch head 0xE544D5 counts (previous op, op) on the sim thread and logs the top 200 pairs / 120 ops every 5 min, after each save and at exit. CallPath=0 in every job (its fast call / ret handlers dispatch the next op through their own head copy, which the counter does not see). Jobs: (1) bp-mintpairs-jiton: master defaults (MonoJit on): what the JIT leaves interpreted = the pairs a superop could still speed up; (2) ip-mintpairs-jiton: same on IP; (3) bp-mintpairs-jitoff: MonoJit.Enabled=0, the vanilla interpreter mix to compare with docs/139 §3's host phases. 11 min each (two interval reports). Data runs, not timing (the counter adds ~10 instructions per dispatch). Household untouched by construction: a counter at the dispatch head, the same handler runs for every op. Read: node tools/harness/mint-pairs.ts mono-measure-mintpairs-1115-<date> -> the docs/139 §3 table rows (dispatches, superop share, top fusable pairs, top 10/20/50 cover). Decision after the run: superops only if the JIT-on top fusable pairs cover a share worth 1-4 ms/s (docs/139 rank 3); else drop D6 (inventory: overlaps MonoJit). Regex cases: the version line is real (master log), the mint pair lines are from the Log formats (no run of the counter yet). Start: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/mono-measure-mintpairs-1115.json --no-smoke
